name: Green & Gair 2020 neural spline flow
source: Paper Fig. 1 (overall structure of the neural spline flow with hyperparameters n_flows = 15, n_hidden = 512, n_blocks = 10, K = 9, n_SVD = 100) and its caption (residual blocks of two fully-connected hidden layers, batch normalisation and ELU before each linear transformation, conditioning on the strain).
unknowns: The strain s enters as a conditioning input (its 100 SVD components) to the residual network of every coupling transform, not through the spine; it is not drawn as a lane.
The rational-quadratic spline transform (K = 9 knots; knots and derivatives output by the residual network), the coupling split and join have no layer symbol and live inside the coupling block.
The 10 residual blocks inside each coupling transform are drawn as one block labelled x10 (a repeat inside a repeat overlaps in the expanded view).
The width of the Permute and Linear layers is not stated (the flow acts on D = 15 parameters).
How the residual network's output layer maps to knots and derivatives is not stated.

nodes.label: Base-space sample u (D = 15), conditioned on strain s
